meta.temperature_K_convention: Pair is [min_K, max_K]. Use 999 (or any value ≥ 500) for max to mean no practical upper bound in the matcher.

general.description: Photosynthetic organisms adapted to extreme environments by minimizing surface area to protect internal tissues. Their outer layer consists of light-transmitting cells with hydrophobic insulation, allowing temperature stability and fluid retention. They anchor via deep root systems and may reproduce through explosive seed dispersal.

species.description: Tall species with multiple growths and sealed pods that open to disperse seeds.
Globular base with tall cylindrical growths bearing clustered seed pods.
Squat structure with lattice-like surface and clustered seed pods.
Swollen five-sided structure topped with an intersecting crown.
Tall cylindrical clusters connected by membrane with a spiked crown; possible symbiotic relationship with attached organisms.

authorNotes.temperature_constraints: Only applies to Carbon dioxide species (180–195 K)
special_rules: Atmosphere type is the PRIMARY filter for species selection
Temperature filtering ONLY applies to CO2 species (cortexum, pullulanta)
Ammonia and Water species have NO temperature constraints listed
Planet type restriction is implicit via atmosphere (Rocky / High Metal Content only)
Color is fully determined by parent star type (no species-specific variation)
